newsitem.title: GREECE: HAMBROS' ALPHA TRUST TO MARKET GUINNESS FLIGHT FUNDS.
newsitem.headline: HAMBROS' ALPHA TRUST TO MARKET GUINNESS FLIGHT FUNDS.

text.p: Following the merger of Hambros Fund Management Plc (HFM) and Guinness Flight Global Asset Management in March 3, its Greek subsidiary Alpha Trust SA will market Guinness Flight Hambro mutual funds in Greece, it said.

HFM parent company Hambros Plc aimed to boost its asset management through mergers and acquisitions. The first such merger with Guinness Flight completes the first round of planned acquisitions, it said.
"The resulting company -- Guinness Flight Hambro -- becomes a more competitive player in the field," Hambros Hellenic Mutual Funds said.
"It becomes one of the 20 largest UK fund managers with total assets of #9.3 billion, a staff 350 and consolidated revenues of #36.5 million."
